name: labs/ad-sdl__bmg_module
title: BMG microplate reader incubator and status (sidecar.bmg_interface.BmgCom)
intro: BMG microplate reader incubator and status (sidecar.bmg_interface.BmgCom), adapted from ad-sdl/bmg_module. It reads `version`, `status`, `error`, `temperature_1` and 2 more; sets `setpoint`; runs `heater_off`. `heater_off`: switch the incubator off (native set_temp(0.0), Temp 0.0); takes no input and runs during an e-stop. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/ad-sdl__bmg_module --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/ad-sdl__bmg_module --backend fake --mcp
